blocks.alt: Oopar: teeron se jure chhe qadam, question, hypothesis, find sources, evaluate, organize aur report, har ek chhote note ke saath. Neeche baen: research ethics ke paanch usool ek ek line ke maani ke saath. Neeche daen: patent, trademark, copyright, industrial design aur trade secret ki table, har ek kya bachata hai aur kitab ki misal.
blocks.caption: Research ke qadam, research ethics aur intellectual property (topics 8.2 se 8.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Research project wazeh sawal se qabil-e-aazmaish hypothesis, phir libraries aur databases mein maakhaz dhoondne, unhein parakhne (maslan kya peer-reviewed hain), notes aur files munazzam karne, aur har maakhaz ke hawale ke saath nataij batane tak jata hai. Akhlaqi research shurakaa ki soch samajh kar raza leti, un ke jawab raaz rakhti, kabhi jaali data ya plagiarism nahi karti, nuqsan se bachti aur faisla saboot par chhorti hai, tarafdari par nahi. Intellectual property ijadat ko patents, brands ko trademarks, takhleeqi kaam ko copyright, product ki shakal ko industrial designs aur raazdarana maharat ko trade secrets se bachati hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi intellectual property ki qism NAHI (MCQ 9)? Trademark ka maqsad bataiye (short question 7). Copyright patent se kaise mukhtalif hai (short question 8)?
blocks.explanation: (d) physical properties. Trademark maal ya khidmat ka maakhaz batata hai, to gahak brand pehchante aur doosre us ka naam ya logo copy nahi kar sakte. Copyright kitabon, music aur software jaise takhleeqi kaam ke izhar ko bachata hai; patent ijad, yaani naye product ya takneeki tareeqe, ko bachata hai aur sirf darkhwast par, aam taur par mehdood saalon ke liye, milta hai.

blocks.prompt: IP ki qismein misalon ke saath aur har ek mukhtalif takhleeqat ko kaise bachati hai, bataiye (long question 5). Class activity: rozana istemal ki cheez mein IP pehchanein.
blocks.explanation: Patents ijadat (solar panel) ko bachate, doosron ko muqarrar arse tak banane ya bechne se rokte hain. Trademarks brand ki pehchan (National Foods logo) bachate hain. Copyright takhleeqi izhar (novel, music, software) bachata hai. Industrial designs product ki shakal (bottle) bachate hain. Trade secrets raazdarana maharat (drink ki recipe) bachate hain jab tak raaz rahe. Maslan mobile phone mein technology ke patents, trademark shuda brand naam aur logo, mehfooz design aur copyright wala software hota hai.
